title: "Does it integrate with our existing system?"
dek: What an API actually is, why the answer is never yes or no, and how to turn the question that kills most deals into the one that scopes them.

title: Where the bank's data actually sits
dek: Live system, reporting copy, data warehouse. Three places the same number lives, three different truths, and the one a bank's analytics team is really asking you about.

title: The security review that quietly kills the deal
dek: Encryption, access control and Nghị định 13/2023 — in the words a Head of IT Security uses, and the four things to raise yourself before they ask.

title: Cloud, on-prem, or the thing in between
dek: Why a Vietnamese bank cannot simply move to AWS, what a hybrid answer looks like, and how hosting decides your price before anyone talks about features.

title: What happens when the other bank is down
dek: Queues, retries and the money that must not be lost or sent twice. The mechanism behind every "transfer is being processed" message a customer has ever seen.

title: Why the pilot took nine months
dek: Environments, UAT, change windows and the year-end freeze. Read a bank's delivery calendar and you will stop promising dates you cannot hold.

title: Reading an architecture diagram in a meeting
dek: Every box, every arrow, and the three questions that make a bank's architect decide you are worth talking to. The lesson that ties the other seven together.
